'''Wind Blast''' is an [[Wind spells|air]]-based [[Blast spells|blast spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 41 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

It is the strongest wind spell available to [[free-to-play]] players, as well as the most cost-effective blast spell to cast.

==Damage==
Wind Blast's base maximum hit starts at 13 and increases as the player unlocks additional blast spells, up to 16 at level 59 Magic.

As with all combat spells, Wind Blast's maximum hit is also increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As an air-based spell, Wind Blast's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to air]].

== Notable uses ==

* Wind Blast is the most cost-effective blast spell, since it deals the same amount of damage as the other blast spells while requiring the least amount of runes. Therefore, it is generally preferred over the other blast spells unless the player is fighting a monster with a specific [[elemental weakness]].
* During the [[Family Crest]] quest, the player must deal damage to the demon [[Chronozon]] with Wind Blast (along with each of the other three blast spells) at least once in order to defeat it.
